title: Wiki render does not validate internal .md links
description:
Researcher second-pass on research-pod wiki (11 concepts, 51 sources).

**Gap:** `kbs wiki render` does not validate wiki-internal `.md` links. A page can render while pointing at missing concept/source files, so a port can ship dead links silently.

**Need:**
- `kbs wiki lint` / `kbs wiki check` must fail on broken relative `.md` links
- `kbs wiki render` should warn on broken links (non-blocking) so operators see problems during preview

**Delivered in:** PR #172 (cursor/wiki-research-kb-d8c6)
